leads.title: Ley de Identidad de Género (Gender Identity Law) - 2012
leads.documents: Allows adults to change legal gender, image and birth name on civil registries without doctor or judge approval; mandates sex reassignment surgery and hormone therapy as part of public/private health care plans
leads.detail: Cited as passed 2012, Senate unanimously approved; described as 'one of the world's most comprehensive transgender rights laws'

leads.title: Decreto 476/2021 - Necessity and Urgency Decree on non-binary ID
leads.documents: Mandates National Registry of Persons (RENAPER) to allow third gender option 'X' on all national identity cards and passports, including for non-citizen permanent residents
leads.detail: Signed 20 July 2021 by President Alberto Fernández; issued in compliance with Gender Identity Law

leads.title: Penal Code Article 80(4) - Hate Crime Amendment 2012
leads.documents: Provides penalty up to life imprisonment for hate crimes/killings based on sexual orientation, gender identity or expression
leads.detail: Article 80(4) Delitos contra las personas, 'Crime against individuals': life imprisonment for killing for pleasure, greed and hatred based on racial, religious reasons, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression

leads.title: Federal Court ruling April 2025 on minor gender-affirming care ban
leads.documents: Rules February 2025 ban by President Javier Milei government on gender affirming care under age 18 unconstitutional, restoring access nationwide
leads.detail: Ban described as part of Milei's war on 'woke ideology' Feb 2025; Federal Court reversal April 2025

leads.title: Supreme Court ruling 2006 - Asociación de Lucha por la Identidad Travesti-Transsexual
leads.documents: Overturned lower court ruling, affirmed transgender people have legal right to organize and campaign for rights
leads.detail: Association created 1997 to defend transgender rights; first victory 2006 Supreme Court reversal

leads.title: Supreme Court ruling 2007 - minor's sex change
leads.documents: Affirmed 17-year-old had legal right to go through sex change process and have legal documents changed
leads.detail: Cited as 2007 Supreme Court precedent for youth transition and document change

leads.title: 2023 court testimony of trans women survivors of dictatorship blacksite
leads.documents: Documents state hunting of trans women, imprisonment at regime blacksite, forced sexual acts in exchange for food; related cleansing campaigns
leads.detail: Testified in court in 2023; context: 1978 World Cup 'cleansing' arrests/beatings, and Comando Cóndor Jan 1982-Jan 1983 murder of 18 gay men including FLH activist

leads.title: World Health Organization citation 2015
leads.documents: Cites Argentina as exemplary country for providing transgender rights
leads.detail: WHO 2015 exemplary-country designation referenced in article lead

leads.title: BBC Mundo report 2014 - 'Argentina leads the trans revolution in the world'
leads.documents: Documents creation of alternative schools and first transgender community centre under Gender Identity Law framework
leads.detail: BBC Mundo 2014 report quoted verbatim in article

leads.title: Agence France-Presse report 2015 - leniency in anti-gay child rape case
leads.documents: Documents judge reduced sentence of man convicted of raping six-year-old boy on basis child had 'homosexual orientation'; enforcement failure and official response
leads.detail: AFP reported Aníbal Fernández called for impeachment of judges, describing as 'one of the biggest disgraces we've ever seen in this country'
